title: Policy Crafting Sandbox: interactive simulator and contextual validation for routing rules
creator: Marco Ruiz
description:
Summary: Build an interactive 'Policy Crafting Sandbox' inside Console that lets customers author routing policies (region selection, tier routing, model-variant fallbacks) and run lightweight simulations/validations before saving or rolling out. Goals: reduce policy misconfigurations, surface cross-region compliance/cost tradeoffs, and provide deterministic previews of routing outcomes for representative request traces.

Scope: Console editor surface + validation engine + simulation preview. Editor supports: region-level selection (explicit/conditional), tier routing (priority/weight), fallback chains mapped to model variants and quantization levels, and per-rule annotations for SLO/cost overrides. Validation checks include: incompatible region-model pairs (e.g., model not deployed in region), tier routing cycles, unreachable fallbacks, policy size/complexity limits, and cost-estimate threshold warnings. Simulation provides: summary heatmap of routed requests, per-region latency/cost breakdown, and example request traces showing chosen route and fallback at each step.

Trade-offs and decisions: We prioritize fast feedback within the Console over running large-scale simulations. The initial simulator will sample representative traces produced from a customer-provided sample or autogenerated synthetic traces (common prompt shapes). We will not attempt full production traffic replay in v1 to avoid data volume and privacy concerns. Validation will be deterministic; for non-deterministic outcomes (e.g., randomized tier weights) the preview will show probability distributions and example outcomes.

Acceptance criteria: Editor allows saving a policy object with region/tier/fallback configuration; validation runs pre-save and blocks on critical errors; preview runs in under 3s for sample sets <= 500 traces; preview includes latency and estimated cost deltas for each candidate route; documentation (Console help + design spec) published; integration tests for 5 canonical policy patterns.

Out-of-scope for v1: live traffic shadowing, automated rollout decisions, deep legal/compliance rules enforcement (we will show flags and link to compliance docs), and complex cost modeling beyond token-per-request heuristics.

Links and artifacts: design brief: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RUNTIME/Policy+Crafting+Sandbox; mockups: Drive/Redwood/Console/PolicySandbox/mockups_v2.pdf; backend hooks and schema: github.com/redwood-inference/routing-service/pulls/492; prototyping branch: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1140
